patch:
diff --git a/main.py b/main.py
index 0000000..1111111 100644
--- a/main.py
+++ b/main.py
@@ -1,9 +1,109 @@
-class BowlingGame:
-    def __init__(self):
-        pass
-
-    def roll(self, pins):
-        pass
-
-    def score(self):
-        pass
+class BowlingGame:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.rolls = []
+        self.frame_scores = []
+        self.current_frame = 0
+        self.frame_rolls = []
+        self.is_finished = False
+
+    def roll(self, pins):
+        if self.is_finished:
+            raise ValueError("Cannot roll after game is over")
+        
+        if pins < 0:
+            raise ValueError("Negative roll is invalid")
+            
+        if pins > 10:
+            raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+            
+        # Check if we're in the 10th frame and have already completed it
+        if self.current_frame >= 10:
+            # We might still be in the process of filling balls for the 10th frame
+            # But we need to make sure we don't exceed the allowed rolls
+            if len(self.frame_rolls) >= 2 and not (self.frame_rolls[0] == 10 or sum(self.frame_rolls[:2]) == 10):
+                # 10th frame is complete with open frame
+                raise ValueError("Cannot roll after game is over")
+            elif len(self.frame_rolls) >= 3:
+                # 10th frame is complete with spare or strike
+                raise ValueError("Cannot roll after game is over")
+        
+        # For frames 1-9, check if valid roll
+        if self.current_frame < 10:
+            if len(self.frame_rolls) == 0:
+                # First roll of frame
+                self.frame_rolls.append(pins)
+                if pins == 10:  # Strike
+                    self.rolls.extend(self.frame_rolls)
+                    self.current_frame += 1
+                    self.frame_rolls = []
+            elif len(self.frame_rolls) == 1:
+                # Second roll of frame
+                if self.frame_rolls[0] + pins > 10:
+                    raise ValueError("Pin count exceeds pins on the lane")
+                self.frame_rolls.append(pins)
+                self.rolls.extend(self.frame_rolls)
+                self.current_frame += 1
+                self.frame_rolls = []
+        else:
+            # 10th frame
+            self.frame_rolls.append(pins)
+            
+            # Check if 10th frame is complete
+            if len(self.frame_rolls) >= 2:
+                # If first two rolls are not strike or spare, frame is complete
+                if not (self.frame_rolls[0] == 10 or sum(self.frame_rolls[:2]) == 10):
+                    self.rolls.extend(self.frame_rolls)
+                    self.is_finished = True
+                elif len(self.frame_rolls) == 3:
+                    # If we have a third roll, frame is complete
+                    self.rolls.extend(self.frame_rolls)
+                    self.is_finished = True
+
+    def score(self):
+        if not self.is_finished and self.current_frame < 10:
+            raise ValueError("Score cannot be taken until the end of the game")
+            
+        # Handle case where game ended but we haven't marked it as finished
+        if self.current_frame >= 10 and len(self.frame_rolls) > 0:
+            # Check if 10th frame is actually complete
+            if len(self.frame_rolls) >= 2:
+                if not (self.frame_rolls[0] == 10 or sum(self.frame_rolls[:2]) == 10) or len(self.frame_rolls) >= 3:
+                    self.rolls.extend(self.frame_rolls)
+                    self.is_finished = True
+        
+        if not self.is_finished:
+            raise ValueError("Score cannot be taken until the end of the game")
+            
+        score = 0
+        roll_index = 0
+        
+        for frame in range(10):
+            if roll_index >= len(self.rolls):
+                raise ValueError("Not enough rolls to score the game")
+                
+            # Check for strike
+            if self.rolls[roll_index] == 10:
+                # Strike: 10 + next two rolls
+                if roll_index + 2 >= len(self.rolls):
+                    raise ValueError("Not enough rolls to score the game")
+                score += 10 + self.rolls[roll_index + 1] + self.rolls[roll_index + 2]
+                roll_index += 1
+            else:
+                # Check for spare or open frame
+                if roll_index + 1 >= len(self.rolls):
+                    raise ValueError("Not enough rolls to score the game")
+                    
+                frame_score = self.rolls[roll_index] + self.rolls[roll_index + 1]
+                
+                if frame_score == 10:
+                    # Spare: 10 + next roll
+                    if roll_index + 2 >= len(self.rolls):
+                        raise ValueError("Not enough rolls to score the game")
+                    score += 10 + self.rolls[roll_index + 2]
+                else:
+                    # Open frame
+                    score += frame_score
+                    
+                roll_index += 2
+                
+        return score
